notes.title: Pixi Version 1.1.2! Speedrun-only fixes!
notes.notes:
An even more minor update to the previous one, all about the speedrun mode introduced in 1.1. 


 Fixed a bug only appearing in speedrun mode where the background color doesn't have the time to be removed with the lack of text.
 Fixed choices in a few places on speedrun mode.
 Fixed how the game show the time once getting the 100% ending. In speedrun mode, again.


Have fun, but especially, have a great speedrun!

notes.title: Pixi Version 1.1.1! Bugs squashed, typo fixed and changes made!
notes.notes:
Pixi hopes you're all doing well. This time it's a very much smaller update than the previous one.



Added arrows in the temple to guide you where to put the stones once you can!

Fixed an important bug softlocking the player when jumping in the final dungeon, when wearing a wig.

Removed all those area intro text in speedrun mode.

Changed some text in speedrun mode to make choices clearer. 

Fixed a few typos in French. (Thanks Enzo!)

Fixed a few typos in English. 

Slightly changed the text to bring back the boat under certain circumstances. 



That's it! Have fun!

notes.title: Version 1.1! The Speedrun of Pixi
notes.notes:
Hello! It's been a little while since I last update the game. As a huge fan of speedruns, I finally decided to make the game so much more accessible to them.



This idea has been trotting in my head for a few months now, and despite the whole way the game is made, I throw together a speedrun mode. It basically acts as a new "language" where more than 98% of the text lines are deleted, leaving only the choices to answer, abbreviated through most of it as Y/N (Yes / No, not "Your Name") 



It's definitely not made for first time players. It's always possible to go back to the title screen and change it back to French or English whenever. The lack of text might bring out a few bugs and issues, but even with the minimal testing done, it should be fine. Feel free to reach out if there's any issues! 



Enjoy! 



PATCH NOTES:

Added Speedrun mode (as an alternative language).

New title screen for speedrun mode.

One single screen has been changed for that mode.
